candidates.name: OGC API - Features Standard
verified_facts: OGC API - Features defines Web API building blocks for querying geospatial features.
Part 1 core uses WGS 84 longitude/latitude by default while Part 2 supports other coordinate reference systems by reference.
semantic_limits: Feature API geometry and CRS support do not establish that a feature is the exact HMLR legal boundary or that its coordinates meet parcel-survey accuracy requirements.

candidates.name: OGC API - Maps Standard
verified_facts: OGC API - Maps presents geospatial data as maps by applying styles.
Clients can request map images and vary size or coordinate reference system parameters.
semantic_limits: A rendered map image is a portrayal product and must not be treated as raw elevation cell values, sensor observations or exact legal-boundary coordinates.
